svg.text: Four routes for structure into MuLAN
② A different hidden layer of the embedder · probed on ProstT5 and Ankh-large, run in ProstT5
Inside the frozen encoder — the layer readout
MuLAN takes last_hidden_state. A linear RidgeCV probe on the site delta (mut − wt at the mutated residue) scores every layer instead. N = 1100.
— probe best 0.765 at layer 3, vs 0.702 at the default layer 24
The final layer is ProstT5's weakest contextualised layer for the local signal — its
pretraining objective translates AA ↔ 3Di, which discards local AA identity.
— probe best 0.799 at layer 47, vs 0.796 at the default layer 48: statistically tied
Ankh's final layer is already near-optimal — span-denoising keeps the top layer general-
purpose. So no Ankh mid-layer run was queued: the probe says there is nothing to win.
shaded by measured probe PCC (site delta)
anchors measured at layers 0–3 and the top three; the interior is drawn at the measured plateau
ProstT5 only — the probe says Ankh has nothing to win
